subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should #38364 remain the umbrella for both Control UI structured reply metadata and no-output terminal-state behavior, or should it be split after #90745/#88032 and #87561 own the remaining work?
rationale: The remaining work crosses gateway protocol, session/runtime context, Control UI, and channel delivery semantics, so maintainers need to choose the durable contract boundary before automation writes another implementation.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review #90745 or a successor for structured reply metadata and let #87561 own final fallback delivery semantics.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this issue only after explicitly confirming the reply metadata and no-output portions are fully tracked by narrower canonical issues or PRs.

options.title: Accept Markdown Reply As Sufficient
options.body: Close the reply portion as satisfied by #92654, accepting Markdown quote text instead of structured reply identity while leaving fallback semantics elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review #90745 or a successor for structured reply metadata and let #87561 own final fallback delivery semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans gateway protocol, Control UI, and agent runtime context boundaries where the history shows adjacent contract work.
